detail_text: This is a Special notice in conjuction with the current sources sought titled Multiple Award Construction Contract (MACC) for F.E. Warren AFB. Session Schedule: Tuesday, April 7, 2026, at 1:00 PM MT Thursday, April 9, 2026, at 1:00 PM MT Please see the Sources Sought posted on SAM titled Multiple Award Construction Contract (MACC) for F.E. Warren AFB for the Meeting ID/Passcode for the sessions. To have the links sent to you directly, please email Natalie Martinez at natalie.martinez.6@us.af.mil.
